name: tool-menu-slide-in
title: Tool Menu Slide In
description: A tool menu enters with short-axis slide and icon stagger.

variables.label: From text
variables.description: The outgoing panel label, on screen before the wipe.

variables.label: To text
variables.description: The incoming panel label. It stays clipped until the timeline wipes it open.

variables.label: Distance
variables.description: Scales the sideways offset the timeline drives on both panels, so they cover a shorter or longer run in the same time.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Colour family of the incoming panel gradient, revealed as the timeline wipes that panel open.
